upstream.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
upstream.note: Skill directories are copied unmodified from the upstream skills/ folder at the pinned commit; nanum-python-analysis is written for this app.

tokenEstimate.method: characters of the skill's line in the omp system prompt / 4 (name + description only; the body is read on demand)

skills.name: nanum-python-analysis

summary.en: House rules for Python analysis of the app's exported data: data policy, reproducibility header, honest reporting, labels.
summary.ko: 앱이 내보낸 데이터를 Python으로 분석할 때의 규칙: 데이터 정책, 재현성 머리말, 정직한 보고, 표기.

skills.reason: Written for this app; always loaded together with the pack.

skills.name: pkpd-modeling

summary.en: PK/PD: non-compartmental analysis (AUC, Cmax, half-life), compartmental and exposure-response models, bioequivalence.
summary.ko: 약동·약력학: 비구획 분석(AUC, Cmax, 반감기), 구획·노출-반응 모형, 생물학적 동등성.

skills.reason: Covers NCA and PK/PD, which the app does not have; scripts need only numpy/scipy and make no network calls.

skills.name: clinical-reports

summary.en: Draft structures and local checks for case, trial, safety and aggregate research reports (synthetic or de-identified inputs only).
summary.ko: 증례·임상시험·안전성·집계 연구 보고서 초안 구조와 로컬 검사(합성·비식별 자료만).

skills.reason: Stdlib-only local scripts; the skill itself requires qualified review and de-identified input.
skills.caveat: SKILL.md mentions optional network access to read public guidance; the app rules (no network) override that.

skills.name: clinical-decision-support

summary.en: Research-only evaluation, evidence-profile, cohort, survival and biomarker/model documentation (not patient care).
summary.ko: 연구용 평가·근거 프로파일·코호트·생존·바이오마커/모형 문서화(환자 진료 아님).

skills.reason: Aggregate clinical decision-support research; explicitly excludes patient care and live operation; stdlib-only scripts, no network.
skills.caveat: Reference URLs only appear in static JSON templates (not fetched).

skills.name: experimental-design

summary.en: Study design before data collection: randomization, blocking, factorial/crossover designs, DOE matrices.
summary.ko: 자료 수집 전 연구 설계: 무작위 배정, 블록화, 요인·교차 설계, 실험계획 행렬.

skills.reason: Experimental design and randomization for trials and lab studies; local numpy/pandas/pydoe only.

skills.name: statistical-power

summary.en: Sample size and power: closed-form and simulation-based (logistic, mixed, cluster, survival), minimum detectable effect.
summary.ko: 표본 수와 검정력: 닫힌 형태·모의실험 기반(로지스틱, 혼합, 군집, 생존), 최소 검출 효과.

skills.reason: Power and sample size justification for protocols; statsmodels-based, no network.

skills.name: scikit-survival

summary.en: Right-censored and competing-risk survival models with leakage-safe preprocessing and censoring-aware metrics.
summary.ko: 우측 중도절단·경쟁위험 생존 모형, 누수 방지 전처리, 중도절단을 반영한 평가 지표.

skills.reason: Goes beyond the app's Kaplan-Meier/Cox: random survival forests, boosting, competing risks. CLIs are local and network-free.
skills.caveat: SKILL.md assumes uv; the app rule (no installing by the agent) overrides it.

skills.name: analytical-method-validation

summary.en: Validation of analytical/bioanalytical procedures: linearity, accuracy, precision, LOD/LOQ, acceptance criteria (ICH Q2, M10).
summary.ko: 분석법 검증(ICH Q2, M10): 직선성, 정확도, 정밀도, 검출·정량 한계, 허용 기준.

skills.reason: Method validation tables for bioanalysis and lab work; scripts are stdlib-only and compute distributions from first principles.
skills.caveat: URLs only in a static standards catalogue (not fetched).

skills.name: exploratory-data-analysis

summary.en: Bounded local exploratory profiles of CSV data: missingness and leakage audits, outliers, transformation sensitivity, EDA report scaffolds.
summary.ko: CSV 자료의 로컬 탐색 프로파일: 결측·누수 점검, 이상치, 변환 민감도, EDA 보고서 틀.

skills.reason: Local, network-free EDA CLIs and report scaffolds; complements csv.column_stats and quality_scan.
skills.caveat: Optional h5py/Pillow/Biopython format helpers are not needed for CSV.

skills.name: statistical-analysis

summary.en: Guided test selection, assumption checks, effect sizes, power, Bayesian alternatives and APA-style reporting.
summary.ko: 검정 선택, 가정 점검, 효과 크기, 검정력, 베이지안 대안, APA 보고 형식.

skills.reason: Fills in what the app's tests lack (assumption diagnostics, effect sizes with CIs, multiple-comparison handling).

skills.name: statsmodels

summary.en: OLS, GLM, discrete and mixed models, ARIMA/SARIMAX with coefficient inference and diagnostics.
summary.ko: OLS·GLM·이산형·혼합 모형, ARIMA/SARIMAX와 계수 추론·진단.

skills.reason: Low-level model API for models beyond csv.run_analysis (time series, count models, robust variants).

skills.name: aeon

summary.en: Time-series machine learning: classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection.
summary.ko: 시계열 기계학습: 분류, 회귀, 군집, 예측, 이상 탐지.

skills.reason: Time-series analysis the app does not have; CPU only.
skills.caveat: Optional deep-learning (TensorFlow) and remote dataset download paths exist; do not use them (no network).

skills.name: scientific-visualization

summary.en: Truthful, accessible, publication-ready scientific figures (Matplotlib/Seaborn): multi-panel layouts, uncertainty display, journal export.
summary.ko: 정확하고 접근성 있는 출판용 그림(Matplotlib/Seaborn): 다중 패널, 불확실성 표시, 학술지 내보내기.

skills.reason: Publication figures; CLIs are network-free (Kaleido/Plotly export not needed).
skills.caveat: Plotly static export needs Chrome; not supported in the managed environment.

skills.name: matplotlib

summary.en: Matplotlib reference for fine-grained plots, plot types and PNG/PDF/SVG export.
summary.ko: Matplotlib 세부 조정, 그래프 종류, PNG/PDF/SVG 내보내기 참고.

skills.reason: Core plotting reference for report figures.

skills.name: seaborn

summary.en: Seaborn statistical plots: distributions, relationships, categorical comparisons, regression displays, heatmaps.
summary.ko: Seaborn 통계 그래프: 분포, 관계, 범주 비교, 회귀, 히트맵.

skills.reason: Fast statistical plots from the exported CSV.
skills.caveat: sns.load_dataset downloads sample data from GitHub; the app rule forbids it, use the exported CSV.

skills.name: polars

summary.en: Polars lazy and streaming DataFrames for large tabular files.
summary.ko: 대용량 표 자료를 위한 Polars 지연·스트리밍 데이터프레임.

skills.reason: Large-file processing beyond memory limits; local only.
skills.caveat: Optional cloud/database/GPU extras are not used.

skills.name: dask

summary.en: Dask DataFrames/Arrays for out-of-core and parallel workloads.
summary.ko: 메모리를 넘는 자료·병렬 처리를 위한 Dask 데이터프레임·배열.

skills.reason: Large-data analysis on one PC (local scheduler).
skills.caveat: Cloud paths and remote clusters are out of scope; use only the local scheduler.

skills.name: scikit-learn

summary.en: Supervised/unsupervised learning, preprocessing, pipelines, cross-validation, tuning and evaluation (including gradient boosting).
summary.ko: 지도·비지도 학습, 전처리, 파이프라인, 교차검증, 튜닝, 평가(그래디언트 부스팅 포함).

skills.reason: Pipelines, calibration, nested CV and metrics beyond the app's ML tools; CPU only.

skills.name: shap

summary.en: SHAP explanations: explainer selection, feature attributions, local and global plots.
summary.ko: SHAP 설명: 설명기 선택, 특성 기여도, 지역·전역 그래프.

skills.reason: Model interpretability, not offered by the app; CPU explainers only.
skills.caveat: Do not load untrusted explainer files (pickle).

skills.name: umap-learn

summary.en: UMAP nonlinear dimension reduction and embeddings for exploration and clustering.
summary.ko: UMAP 비선형 차원 축소와 임베딩(탐색·군집).

skills.reason: Nonlinear embedding that complements the app's PCA/LDA; CPU only.

rejected.name: pymc
rejected.reason: Needs a C/C++ compiler toolchain on Windows for usable sampling speed and pulls a very large dependency set; statistical-analysis covers Bayesian alternatives.

rejected.reason: Needs PyTorch, downloads public/restricted EHR datasets and medical-code resources over the network.

rejected.reason: Produces patient-specific treatment-plan documentation; outside the app's research-only clinical boundary.
